clips.title: The story
paras: In Sludge Fen, Wizzlecrank's Shredder sits trapped among Venture Company operators. Pilot Wizzlecrank climbed inside the machine to steal it, but it will not move without a key. Its engine must be started before the goblin can try to escape.

Deep in Sludge Fen, Wizzlecrank waits inside a motionless shredder. The Venture Company machine is surrounded by hostile mercenaries in the polluted basin. Wizzlecrank climbed aboard to steal it, then learned he needed a key to unlock its movement column. When another shredder operator asked if all was well, he panicked and blamed a mechanical problem. Now he remains sealed inside, with guards and overseers nearby, hoping someone will fetch the key before the Venture Company grows suspicious.
